label: Bible Study
prompt: For where your _____ is, there will your heart be also.
verse: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
note: Follow the money and you'll find the heart — Jesus said it first.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: My sheep hear my _____, and I know them, and they follow me:
verse: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
note: Sheep know their shepherd by sound, not sight — and Jesus says His know His voice the same way.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and _____ up the water that was in the trench.
verse: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
note: On Mount Carmel the fire fell and even licked up the water Elijah had poured into the trench.

label: Deep Water
prompt: There is no fear in love; but perfect love _____ out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
verse: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
note: John's fear diagnostic: fear expects punishment, and grown-up love has nothing left to dread.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And they _____ him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
verse: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
note: 'By the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony' — the classic testimony-service text.
